title: Design System: Ireti Cole, director and photographer

display-hero.purpose: The name over the home reel only; de-squeezes in.

display.purpose: Page titles, the closing call and the next-film title.

title.purpose: Discipline names, card titles, step titles.

label.purpose: Mono uppercase spec labels: kind, ratio, year, credit roles.

shadows.name: letterbox-bars
shadows.purpose: Black bars above and below every framed piece of footage.

shadows.name: letterbox-hairline-glow
shadows.purpose: Glow on the 1px flare gradient hairline at frame edges; 70% opacity, 100% on hover.

shadows.name: closing-streak
shadows.purpose: Horizon streak behind the closing call; brightens with scroll.

shadows.name: header-seam
shadows.purpose: Bottom edge of the solid header.

motion.name: ease
motion.purpose: Default out-curve for CSS state transitions (hover, colour, scale).

motion.name: ease-io
motion.purpose: In-out curve for wipes and slit reveals (GSAP expo.inOut).

motion.name: desqueeze
motion.value: scaleX 2.4 -> 1, blur 10px -> 0, opacity 0 -> 1, 1.6s expo.out, stagger 0.12s, origin left

motion.name: letterbox-reveal
motion.purpose: Media opens from a horizontal slit on first view.

motion.name: flare-wipe
motion.value: streak scaleX 0->1 0.45s expo.out, fill scaleY 0->1 0.6s expo.inOut at 0.2s

motion.name: grain
motion.purpose: Fixed film grain; off under reduced motion.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Site-wide smooth scrolling, disabled under reduced motion.

components.name: Letterbox Frame
components.description: Signature frame for all footage: black bars plus glowing flare hairlines that brighten on hover.
components.css: .ds-stage { background: #07080a; padding: 40px 24px; } .ds-lbx { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 2.39; background: #000; box-shadow: 0 -14px 0 #000, 0 14px 0 #000; } .ds-lbx__img { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1b2a38, #0a0d10 60%); } .ds-lbx::before, .ds-lbx::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; height: 1px; z-index: 2; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(124,196,255,.55) 20%, #cfeaff 50%, rgba(124,196,255,.55) 80%, transparent); box-shadow: 0 0 14px 1px rgba(124,196,255,.35); opacity: .7; transition: opacity .5s cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-lbx::before { top: 0; } .ds-lbx::after { bottom: 0; } .ds-lbx:hover::before, .ds-lbx:hover::after { opacity: 1; }

narrative.overview:
The whole site behaves like footage captured on a widescreen anamorphic lens. The ground is a cool near-black, footage sits in 2.39 frames edged by black letterbox bars, a single flare blue appears as horizontal streaks and as the one action, fine grain drifts over everything, and display type arrives horizontally stretched before settling to true width. The interface recedes; footage and photographs carry the page, and the optics are the only ornament.

Density is low and cinematic: huge uppercase extended titles, generous section padding, and long horizontal hairlines that read as the edges of a frame. Everything is square-cornered. Depth comes from light (streaks, glow, grain) rather than from stacked cards or shadows. Motion is the language of a lens and an edit: a slit opening into a frame, a squeeze relaxing, a streak wiping between pages.

This world replaces the earlier light "darkroom" direction, which was rejected. It also refuses the stock dark reel-plus-grid with a centred logo: the name sits bottom-left over the reel, and selected work is a list of titles rather than a thumbnail grid.
keyCharacteristics: Cool near-black ground, warm-white type, one flare-blue accent.
Letterboxed 2.39 frames with glowing flare hairlines on their edges.
Panchang 800 uppercase display, General Sans for reading, Geist Mono for spec labels.
Sharp corners and hairline rules everywhere; no radius.
Fixed film grain at 4% over every page.
The de-squeeze: display type enters at 2.4x width, blurred, and settles to 1x.
Page transitions are a flare streak that wipes the frame.

rules.name: The One Light Source Rule
rules.body: Flare blue is the only hue in the interface. It appears as light (streaks, hairline glows) or as the single primary action per view. No second accent, no tinted surfaces, no blue body text.

rules.name: The Projection Rule
rules.body: Footage always sits on letterbox black, never on the ground colour, so every frame reads as a screen inside the dark room.

rules.name: The De-Squeeze Rule
rules.body: Display headings enter horizontally stretched (scaleX 2.4, blurred 10px, transparent) and settle to true width over 1.6s on an expo-out curve, line by line, from the left edge. Body text never de-squeezes; it fades up 24px.

rules.name: The Spec Label Rule
rules.body: Mono labels are metadata set beside or below the thing they describe, like credits on a spec sheet. They are never decorative headings above a title.

rules.name: The Light, Not Lift Rule
rules.body: Elements gain presence by glowing (a brighter hairline, a stronger streak) rather than by rising on a shadow. Cards never lift on hover; their media scales 1.03 to 1.04 inside a clipped frame.

rules.name: The Grain Rule
rules.body: One fixed fractal-noise layer at 4% opacity, shifting in six steps per second, covers every page above content and below overlays. It stops under reduced motion.

dos: **Do** frame footage in cinema ratios (2.39, 1.85, the 4.8 slit) on letterbox black with the flare hairline edges.
**Do** keep flare blue to light effects and one primary action per view; use the flare focus outline (2px, 3px offset) on every interactive element.
**Do** set display headings in Panchang 800 uppercase at line-height 0.86 to 0.92 and de-squeeze them in from 2.4x.
**Do** set metadata in Geist Mono 12px uppercase smoke, beside or below what it describes.
**Do** reveal media from a horizontal slit and transition pages with the flare wipe; honour reduced motion by dropping to static.
**Do** separate content with 1px hairlines rather than boxes.
donts: **Don't** add a second accent hue, tint surfaces blue, or use gradient text; the flare gradient belongs to streaks and hairlines only.
**Don't** lift cards or panels on shadows; glow a hairline or scale the media inside its frame instead.
**Don't** fall back to the stock dark reel with a centred logo over a thumbnail grid.
**Don't** place mono labels above headings as kickers or eyebrows.
**Don't** reintroduce the rejected light darkroom palette.
